transition_prior: Hierarchical Train counts over cell/destination bearing-distance/incoming heading; subtract entire departure-week fold at all Train local and total-loss steps; Validation uses all Train; count exclusion does not exclude neural fitting or allowed graph
local_loss: next-zone CE + residence CE + terminal CE + direct OD NLL +5RPS
fine_loss: mixed total NLL +5RPS through differentiable semi-Markov inference
query_input: Same216 OD/departure/map/history features, plus grid IDs derived deterministically from given endpoints
geometry: 200m cells; public2014 roads and Train transitions only; state=(cell,incoming heading4) plus one unknown-heading origin state
time_model: Spatial state transition + positive movement residence + nonnegative terminal residence; marginalize all paths
time_window: Fixed60..1785s for every query; no observed query point count
